calls.summary: The team discussed an e-commerce awareness campaign targeting 2-10 companies to collaborate on proven experiments, with Ashley leading outreach efforts. A password-protected Notion page will host curated content, with an emphasis on clear, user-focused messaging to attract participants. In addition, the pro flow feature is nearing completion and is expected to begin testing within 1-2 weeks, integrating Google Analytics 4 for effective tracking. Progress on industry-specific pages was noted, with FinTech completed and HealthTech and EdTech pending, while enhancements to the About Us page aim to build credibility through storytelling and metrics. Lastly, preparations for the upcoming meeting with Jeremy include reviewing AI content and ensuring legal compliance for the site launch.
